pipeline.asset: RNS System (next label expansion: idiopathic generalized epilepsy)
pipeline.target: Cortical responsive stimulation in seizure focus / generalized network

indications.indication: Drug-resistant idiopathic generalized epilepsy (IGE) with generalized tonic-clonic seizures
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multicenter, randomized, sham-controlled IDE pivotal study; 87 patients implanted across 23 centers; primary safety endpoint at 12 weeks; effectiveness assessed at 1 year; 2-year follow-up ongoing
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING — last patient completed 1-year follow-up Mar 2025; PMA-S submitted Dec 2025; 2-year completion expected H1 2026
key_milestones: Feb 2021: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for IGE
H2 2021: IDE approval to initiate NAUTILUS
May 2025: Preliminary 1-year results — met primary safety endpoint; 77% median GTC seizure reduction at 18 months
Dec 2025: PMA-S filed for IGE label expansion

indications.indication: Drug-resistant epilepsy associated with Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome (LGS)
indications.trial_design: Open-label feasibility study; collaboration with NINDS and University of Florida

indications.indication: Drug-resistant focal epilepsy in pediatric patients (ages 12-17)
indications.trial_design: Open-label IDE study; supplemented since 2025 by collaboration with MDIC NEST and FDA on real-world data for pediatric labeling
indications.trial_status: ONGOING — enrollment began 2021; real-world data efforts continuing into 2026
key_milestones: 2025: Initiated NEST/FDA real-world data collaboration to support pediatric label expansion

commercial_product.name: RNS System
commercial_product.description: Brain-responsive neurostimulator (only FDA-approved closed-loop responsive neurostimulation device). Implantable neurostimulator + depth and/or cortical leads + Patient Remote Monitor + Physician Tablet + PDMS / nSight Platform.
approved_indications: Adjunctive therapy for adults with drug-resistant focal-onset (partial-onset) epilepsy
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA PMA approved; PMA-S 2023 expanded prescribing-clinician/center qualification criteria; Seizure ID AI software submitted to FDA fall 2025

excluded_preclinical: NeuroPace AI software suite beyond Seizure ID
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT00264810 — RNS System Pivotal Study (COMPLETED 2009; supported original PMA approval)
NCT00158067 — External Responsive Neurostimulator System Study (COMPLETED 2007)
excluded_partner_owned: Rapport Therapeutics Phase 2a trial — RNS System used only as biomarker-monitoring/data-analysis collaboration; asset is Rapport's, not NeuroPace's
DIXI Medical Stereo EEG products — distribution agreement expired Sep 30, 2025 (not renewed)
